hero.undertitel: Grow in faith and knowledge – three paths to go deeper

stycken: Every Sunday God's word is shared through the sermon. Our preachers deliver timely, life-changing messages that help you grow in faith and everyday life.
Listen to previous sermons and follow current sermon series here.
Being a parent is life's most important task. We offer teaching and resources to help you build a safe, loving family grounded in faith.
Courses, discussion groups and material for parents at all stages.
In home groups we go deeper into the Bible together. Through study, conversation and prayer we grow in understanding and faith – and support one another along the way.
Current study material and information about the home groups' teaching plan.
